## 6. Regression Analysis

### 6.1 Feature & Target Selection

```{python}
reg_feature_cols = [
    # "feature_1",
    # "feature_2",
]

reg_target_col = "your_regression_target"

X_reg, y_reg = ds.prepare_features_and_target(
    df_fe,
    feature_cols=reg_feature_cols,
    target_col=reg_target_col,
)
```

---

### 6.2 Train/Test Split

```{python}
X_train_reg, X_test_reg, y_train_reg, y_test_reg = ds.split_train_test(
    X_reg,
    y_reg,
    test_size=0.2,
    stratify=False,
    random_state=ds.RANDOM_STATE,
)
```

---

### 6.3 Model Training & Evaluation

```{python}
reg_results = ds.run_regression(
    X_train_reg,
    X_test_reg,
    y_train_reg,
    y_test_reg,
)
reg_results
```

---

### 6.4 Regression Diagnostics

```{python}
y_pred = reg_results["y_pred"]

plt.scatter(y_test_reg, y_pred, alpha=0.7)
plt.xlabel("True Values")
plt.ylabel("Predicted Values")
plt.title("Regression: True vs Predicted")
plt.plot(
    [y_test_reg.min(), y_test_reg.max()],
    [y_test_reg.min(), y_test_reg.max()],
    linestyle="--",
)
plt.show()
```

**Interpret:**

* Bias patterns?
* Over/under-prediction?
* Metric meaning in real-world units?

## 7. Classification Analysis (If Applicable)

```{python}

    # "feature_1",

    df_fe,
    feature_cols=clf_feature_cols,
    target_col=clf_target_col,
)
```

---

### 7.2 Train/Test Split (Stratified)

```{python}
X_train_clf, X_test_clf, y_train_clf, y_test_clf = ds.split_train_test(
    X_clf,
    y_clf,
    test_size=0.2,
    stratify=True,
    random_state=ds.RANDOM_STATE,
)
```

---

### 7.3 Model Training & Evaluation

```{python}

    X_train_clf,

)

```

## 8. Clustering Analysis (If Applicable)

### 8.1 Feature Selection

```{python}
cluster_feature_cols = [
    # "feature_1",
    # "feature_2",
]

X_cluster = df_fe[cluster_feature_cols].dropna()
```

---

### 8.2 Clustering & Evaluation

```{python}
cluster_results = ds.run_clustering(
    X_cluster,
    n_clusters=3,
    random_state=ds.RANDOM_STATE,
)
cluster_results
```

---

### 8.3 Cluster Visualization

```{python}
cluster_labels = cluster_results["labels"]
X_plot = X_cluster.iloc[:, :2].copy()
X_plot["cluster"] = cluster_labels

sns.scatterplot(
    data=X_plot,
    x=X_plot.columns[0],
    y=X_plot.columns[1],
    hue="cluster",
    palette="tab10",
)
plt.title("Clustering Visualization")
plt.show()
```

**Interpret:**

* Do clusters reflect meaningful real-world groups?
* Any surprising segmentation?
